system.description:
Battle Amp

While in this state, you gain the following benefits;

Blast Zone. You are immune to the harmful effects of your Primes, Bakuton Hijutsu and Clan features.

Black Powder Pressure. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature and Prime them, they are marked twice instead of once.

Detonation Momentum. You gain a bonus to your attack critical threat range when attacking a Primed creature. This bonus is equal to the number of Primes they have active on them.
system.summary: Immune to your own Primes and Bakuton effects. Unarmed hits Prime twice, and your crit range grows with the target's Primes.

rules.text: Detonation Momentum: + crit range equal to the Primes on the target (at the table).
